question: Who should satisfy Śiva with his limbs in the principal fire-pit?
premises: Śiva together with his limbs is the object of satisfaction
The act is performed in the principal fire-pit
The wise and best teacher is the agent
inference: The wise best teacher should satisfy Śiva with his limbs in the principal fire-pit
plain_english: The wise and best teacher should satisfy Śiva together with his limbs in the principal fire-pit.
